snippet.title: Cargo Hunters - Official Early Access Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Cargo Hunters is the single player extraction shooter where you control a humanoid robot scavenging the remains of humanity on an abandoned, dystopian Earth. 
NOW ON STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4197990/Cargo_Hunters/
